annotations.description: Playing Island instead of a Thriving land (Thriving Isle or Thriving Moor) when severely behind on land drops. With only 1 land in play, the tapped ETB cost is minimal since they can't fully utilize their mana this turn anyway. A Thriving land would provide dual-color fixing from a single land slot, which is strictly better for a 3-color (or at least UB) mana base.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Island, providing only blue mana
annotations.betterLine: Play Thriving Isle (choosing black) or Thriving Moor (choosing blue) to get a dual-color land while the tapped ETB drawback has minimal tempo cost

annotations.description: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice (2/2) is blocked by Lightning-Core Excavator (0/3). Without intervention, the Accomplice dies and the Excavator survives. The opponent is fully tapped out with no mana to respond.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, allowing combat damage to resolve - Accomplice dies, Excavator lives.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Eliminate targeting Lightning-Core Excavator before damage. This saves the Accomplice (2/2 attacker survives) AND removes the Excavator, effectively gaining a 2-for-1 instead of losing a creature for nothing.

annotations.description: Attempted to cast Mesa Unicorn but the mana payment was rolled back, resulting in no action taken. Even if the Mesa Unicorn cast had succeeded, Crypt Lurker was the stronger play - it costs {3}{B} (payable with 3 Swamps + Plains for generic), provides a 3/4 body, and could sacrifice the tapped Ghoulcaller's Accomplice to draw a card (with Accomplice still having graveyard exile value later). The failed cast wasted the opportunity to develop the board meaningfully.
